summary: Validated the two audio-engine fixes (Issue 1 screen-lock isochronic artifacts; Issue 2 silent-playback after frequency change). All 9 test scenarios from the review request passed. Added a test-only window.__audioEngine handle in /app/frontend/src/lib/audioEngine.js to enable probing from Playwright — main agent should remove or gate it behind NODE_ENV before ship.

test_results_detail.methods_exist: ensureRunning, freezeIsochronicForBackground, resumeIsochronicAfterBackground, _postStartHealthCheck all present and callable
test_results_detail.rapid_stop_start_cycle: 4 clicks @ 200ms — final state consistent (playing/osc/gate coherent). Note: initial rapid-click test on fresh page was intercepted by Wellness Assistant modal overlay (unrelated to audio); subsequent tests confirmed correctness.
test_results_detail.frequency_switching_stress: Stop → different preset (528, 396, 741) within 200ms — each yielded playing=true, osc!=null, gateGain!=null, correct frequency. Directly validates the gateGain-local-capture fix in stop(). BEFORE this fix the stale 850ms cleanup would null-out the fresh session's gateGain.
test_results_detail.isochronic_visibility_freeze: setIsochronic(7) → isoLfo populated at 7 Hz. document hidden → isoLfo=null, _isoFrozen=true, playing=true (carrier unaffected). document visible → isoLfo recreated (truthy again, new instance), _isoFrozen=false, isochronic restored to 7.
test_results_detail.health_check_auto_recovery: Corrupted gateGain=null 100ms after start. After 3s: gateGain=true, osc=true, playing=true (silent restart worked).
test_results_detail.normal_playback_stability: Osc reference unchanged over 2.2s of healthy playback — health check does NOT trigger unwanted restart when graph is intact.

critical_code_review_comments: audioEngine.js is 1249 lines — exceeds the 700-line file-size guideline. Consider splitting into ambient / tone / isochronic / robustness modules.
window.__audioEngine handle I added is currently unconditional. Recommend wrapping in `if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production')` before production build, OR remove after verification.

_postStartHealthCheck fires stop()+start() unconditionally when broken, but the 900ms wait inside health-check + 850ms cleanup + 800ms fade-in means a corruption-triggered recovery is ~1.7s of silence — acceptable for a rare edge case but worth noting in code comment.

freezeIsochronicForBackground uses class-field syntax (_isoFrozen = false at class level) — verify Babel/webpack config supports it in all target browsers. It works in the current preview but is a subtle stylistic mismatch with the rest of the file that assigns state in the constructor.
action_items: Remove (or gate on NODE_ENV) the `window.__audioEngine = audioEngine` line at the bottom of /app/frontend/src/lib/audioEngine.js before shipping. Testing agent added it to enable probing.
Optional: initialize _isoFrozen / _isoRateBeforeHide in the constructor rather than via class fields for consistency with the rest of the file.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Audio-engine fixes validated end-to-end via window.__audioEngine handle. If main agent removes the window handle, use React DevTools or add a test-mode branch to re-probe. Preview URL: https://frequency-healer-31.preview.emergentagent.com.
